name: Large sets without a triple and all its pair sums
description: construct() -> distinct integers in 1..128. Forbid THREE DISTINCT members a,b,c for which a+b, a+c and b+c are also selected. The six displayed values need not be mutually distinct. Maximize set size. The local interval ends at 128. The evaluator uses only exact finite checks and does not assume the preprint’s proof, novelty, status, or Lean verification. The baseline is the elementary upper half interval.
